summary: Frontend-only testing of the native Expo mobile logistics app connected to the live remote backend (https://logistics-hub-1349.emergent.host). Verified all 5 tabs (Overview, Shipments, Ledger, Parties, More) render with real live-backend data, all key flows (shipment list -> detail -> advance status, new-shipment form, ledger tab switching, party list -> detail, more-menu navigation to Invoices/Items/Warehouses/Lalamove, sync-now action) work. Verified tablet two-pane layout at 1280x800 for Shipments and Parties (embedded ShipmentDetail and PartyDetail render alongside the list with lime border on selected row). Verified True Black + lime palette, status pills, testIDs on core interactive elements. No console/page errors seen at any viewport. Two minor issues found: (1) large empty vertical gap between the role/filter chips row and the first party row on the Parties tab (visible on both mobile and tablet), and (2) the parties-list search TextInput lacks a testID (all other search inputs have one).

ui_bugs.issue: Large empty vertical gap (~250-300px) appears between the role-filter chips row and the first party row on both mobile (390x844) and tablet (1280x800). The list content is pushed way down leaving a big black area at the top of the list column. Likely caused by FlatList height/flex distribution or content alignment inside the list column. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/parties.tsx around the FlatList (lines 95-145) and styles.listContent.

The search input on the Parties tab has no testID. All other search inputs (e.g. shipments-search) have one. Add testID="parties-search" for parity and testability. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/parties.tsx line 71.

issues: Excessive empty space above the party list rows makes the screen feel broken on first load. The role chips should sit immediately above the first party card with only 8-16px spacing.

action_items: Fix the Parties list vertical gap: inspect FlatList container flex/height in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/parties.tsx. Ensure the list content starts right below the filter chips (no extra flex-grow or centered content in the wrapping View).
Add testID="parties-search" to the TextInput at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/parties.tsx line 71 for parity with shipments-search.
critical_code_review_comments: All screens correctly use SafeAreaView, StyleSheet.create, and RN primitives (View/Text/TouchableOpacity). No HTML elements found.

testID coverage is very good overall (new-shipment-btn, filter-*, shipment-row-*, advance-status-btn, save-shipment-btn, role-*, ledger-tab-*, more-* all present). Only parties search input is missing one.
EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly consumed from env; no hard-coded URLs seen in api/client.ts.

success_rate.backend: n/a (remote live backend, not tested per instructions)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% - all flows work; 2 minor UI/testID issues

seed_data_creation: None - did not create any new test data on the live remote backend, only read existing data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend at https://opsi-complete.preview.emergentagent.com talks to the remote live backend at https://logistics-hub-1349.emergent.host. No auth. Tested at mobile 390x844 (Samsung S26 Ultra profile) and tablet 1280x800 (Samsung Tab S11 profile). Tablet two-pane confirmed on shipments and parties tabs. Real data present: 5 shipments (CN-1002..CN-1006), 6 parties (Deepak, Lalit, Priya Traders, Rahul HandCarrier, Somchai, Raj Hand-Carrier), 3 items (Bedsheets, Cotton fabric, Silk saree), 1 warehouse (Bangkok Warehouse, default). Ledger summary shows receivable INR 0/THB 48,780 and payable INR 21,350/THB 0. No console/page errors at any viewport.
rca_of_issue: Parties list large gap: most likely a flex/height issue where the FlatList's parent has flex: 1 with justifyContent that centers content, or the list has significant top padding. Suggest inspecting styles.listContent and the containing View in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/parties.tsx. Reproduction: navigate to /parties on any viewport - the party rows appear ~300px below the filter chips instead of immediately after them.
